UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Authenticated user profile metadata and synchronized portfolio UI customization settings.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the signed-in user badge.

photoUrl.description: Optional avatar URL from Google Auth.

cardStyle.description: Selected visual theme mode across the portfolio.

surfaceDepth.description: Surface elevation preference (flat minimalist or layered depth).

layerDepth.description: Layer card shadow depth intensity percentage (0 to 200).

autoTimeTheme.description: Whether Ice-Blue theme automatically toggles Light/Dark by time of day.

activeWallpaperId.description: Identifier of the user's active wallpaper preset or custom wallpaper.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when user settings were first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest user settings update.

CustomWallpaper.title: CustomWallpaper
CustomWallpaper.description: A user-saved custom background wallpaper synced under the owner's user document.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the wallpaper owner.

name.description: Human-readable name of the custom wallpaper.

value.description: Image/video URL or CSS background value.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the custom wallpaper was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the custom wallpaper was last modified.

ContactInquiry.title: ContactInquiry
ContactInquiry.description: Direct consultation or recruitment inquiry submitted by an authenticated visitor.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who submitted the inquiry.

organization.description: Company or organization name (empty string if individual).

message.description: Body of the consultation or collaboration inquiry.

tags.description: Bounded list of up to 5 short topic tags.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the inquiry ('archived' is terminal and immutable).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update to the inquiry.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user portfolio UI preferences and profile metadata; strictly owner-accessible.

/users/{userId}/wallpapers/{wallpaperId}.description: User-owned custom wallpapers subcollection protected by parent user document Master Gate.

/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Direct inquiries created by verified authenticated visitors; strictly scoped to authorId.
